name: send_email
description: Send an email. Required: `to` + `body`; `subject` is optional. Can also reach a phone via the SMS-via-email gateway. To attach files, pass `pod_ids` (see that field). Do not use email to talk to the user directly unless explicitly instructed.

inputs.name: pod_ids
inputs.description: Optional list of pod URIs to attach. Pass each pod_id EXACTLY as returned by pod_search or mint_pod_from_path — including the `datapod:<kind>:` prefix. Do NOT strip the prefix to bare hex; lookup is exact-match and a stripped id will fail with 'missing pods'. Each pod must have a backing file via metadata.stored_path; image/video/audio/document pods all work. The file is attached with its original filename and inferred MIME type. If any pod is missing the whole send fails — mint a fresh pod via mint_pod_from_path (or call bash_manager) instead of guessing.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for sending an email:
to: str
subject: Optional[str]
body: Optional[str]
pod_ids: Optional[List[str]]  # Pod URIs to attach as files (e.g. ['datapod:image:abc...']). Find pod_ids first via pod_search (kind='image', linked_to_entity=...).

metadata.planner_description: Send an email (or SMS via email gateway).
